title: Slice equivalence for explicit relative coefficient transport
statement:
theorem relativeFiniteModelSliceEquivalence {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    (F G : pbcModules Y ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (adicLisseConstantRing X B)))
    (V : proEtaleSiteModel Y) :
    Nonempty (F.over (AsSmall.down.obj V) ≅ G.over (AsSmall.down.obj V)) ↔
      Nonempty (((relativeFiniteModelModules g B).obj F).over V ≅
        ((relativeFiniteModelModules g B).obj G).over V)

proof.text: Use AsSmall.equiv to make AsSmall.down an equivalence, with the induced pro-etale model topology making it a dense subsite. Apply NativeRestriction.sliceDense and sliceModulesEquivalence to V and the inverse-image constant commutative ring R. The proved restrictModules_standardIso identifies this slice module equivalence with the identity-ring-map pushforward T along Over.post AsSmall.down.

Apply the sheaf overPullback functor to the ring isomorphism obtained by forgetting commutativity in relativeFiniteModelCoefficient. Restriction of scalars along this slice ring isomorphism c is an equivalence: the Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence construction for the identity site equivalence and c.hom,c.inv gives its inverse, with the two compatibility equations supplied by the ring isomorphism identities.

Compose the slice-site pushforward T with restriction of scalars along c.hom to obtain E. On F.over (AsSmall.down.obj V) and G.over (AsSmall.down.obj V), its objects are definitionally the restrictions to V of relativeFiniteModelModules g B. An isomorphism on the original slice maps forward by E.mapIso; an isomorphism on the transported slice lifts back by E.preimageIso, since E is fully faithful.

proof_origin.note: H2: complete Lean proof, no split-off statements and no new sorry. The independent-universe slice restriction theorem is used as an already proved categorical tool; the proper-base-change unit route is unchanged.
